name: Cognitive Resource Meter
actions: guide or import a provider-bound goal receipt
measure an explicit local Workshop process window
seal and reuse privacy-safe machine profiles
archive and supersede versioned rate schedules
explain held evidence without automatic repair
export exact Mirror drafts or portable evidence bundles
archive restore or supersede a cognitive record
summary: Capture machine-bound cognitive-work and separated resource-rate evidence as strict content-addressed drafts that Mirror may independently inspect, seal, and transform.
notes: Evidence producer only. It never converts tokens to universal compute, calculates Mirror results, certifies price freshness, ranks or selects a model/provider/hardware/plan, allocates a budget, writes Mirror, trains, promotes CANON, or acts.
